task: DENTE Desktop CT Viewer Detection, External Launch, Downloads Scanner, and Multi-Monitor CBCT Popout Bridge

implementedIpcChannels.purpose: Detects installed external CT viewers (PicassoViewer, Ez3D2009, Ez3D-i, Romexis, OnDemand3D, CS 3D, i-Dixel, Sidexis/Galileos, NewTom NNT) and Windows .dcm file associations. Always guarantees internal DENTE CBCT Studio (Zero Dead-Ends).
Spawns external CT viewer executable with study/DICOM path safely using child_process.spawn with detached: true, stdio: 'ignore', and unref(). Fallback routes to internal CBCT popout window.

Asynchronously inspects %USERPROFILE%\Downloads and hot folders for recent CT archives/folders (<7 days, maxDepth 2, <450ms timeout protection). Extracts patient hints and detects modalities (CBCT, CT, DICOM_ARCHIVE, DICOM_FOLDER).
Opens independent Electron BrowserWindow for /cbct-studio with WebGL acceleration, auto multi-monitor detection, and focus management.

webFallbacks.detectInstalledCtViewers: Returns DENTE CBCT Studio with isDefault: true
webFallbacks.scanDownloadsForCt: Returns empty array (zero mocks in web)
webFallbacks.launchExternalCtViewer: Routes internal studio to window.open(/cbct-studio), prompts desktop app for external viewers
webFallbacks.openCbctPopoutWindow: Opens secondary browser window with dimensions and features
